TSA allows gate access without plane tickets at select airports

The Transportation Security Administration (TSA) has reintroduced a program allowing certain individuals without plane tickets to access airport gates. This initiative, which began at some airports on Monday, aims to provide gate access for various purposes, including meeting passengers, assisting travelers, and shopping. The program is being rolled out 25 years after the September 11th attacks, which led to stricter airport security measures and the discontinuation of such access. The TSA stated the program is designed to enhance the airport experience for non-travelers while maintaining security.
